name: writing-cowork
description: Multi-role cowork pattern (PM, substance, voice/tone, review) for long-form writing projects. Skills install scaffolds, manage drift, run reviews, and coordinate role handoffs across a project's git-tracked vault. **v0.1.16:** drift_check.py incorporated into the plugin (0_Product/tools/), report filenames now include time-of-day, drift_check.py carries its own independent version marker, pm-migrate-to-shared-tool replaced by the more general pm-sync-project-to-plugin (setup/upgrade/refresh in one skill).
